title: Nuclear test sites with Marines dug in nearby

tellings.quote: they detonated nukes where they had the Marines like embedded right next to where the the explosions were going off

plain: In the 1950s, at the Nevada Test Site where the US exploded nuclear bombs, the military is said to have set off blasts with Marines dug in "right next to where the explosions were going off." Randy Anderson, a guest who says he saw alien technology at a military base, tells this himself. He offers it as an example of how far the military would go in testing on its own people.
